source_refs.note: Ideal Fluid: a main subheading of 5.8 Steady, non-viscous and ideal fluid, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 104-104.

blocks.text: The behaviour of the fluid which satisfies the following conditions is called ideal fluid:

items: The fluid is non-viscous i.e., there is no frictional force between adjacent layers of the fluid.
The fluid is incompressible i.e., its density is constant.
